conditions: The parameter is an &optional entry of an ordinary lambda list.
limitations: Macro lambda lists, keyword argument matching and the scoping of initializer forms have separate rules.

triggers: Exact publisher representation changed, source correction, or contrary language or edition evidence.

statement: For an optional parameter of an ordinary lambda list, HyperSpec 7.0 describes binding the next remaining argument when one is supplied. Otherwise it evaluates the initializer, or uses nil when the initializer is absent. A supplied-p variable, when present, indicates whether an argument was supplied.
